reviews.text:
HIGHLY RECOMMEND IT
Thank you so so much Emi for the amazing work you have put into helping and caring for my dog. The kindness, compassion and professionalism is above and beyond. She took care of my dog since she was a puppy and I cannot recommend her and the clinic enough. Also staff is very good, friendly, kind and compassionate.. such an amazing team! Thank you everyone you really are making a difference here❤️❤️❤️

Friendly, fun, and highly professional!

We cannot thank Dr. Emi, nurse Tania, and their incredible team enough. Both the vet and the entire staff are extremely kind, helpful, and efficient. Emi and Tania are incredibly attentive and always available for follow-ups whenever needed, showing a level of care that goes far beyond the call of duty.
This place is not just a professional clinic, but a truly welcoming home. They pay so much attention to detail and showered our puppy, Ragù, with love—completely winning him over with a little dog-friendly ice cream! Our cat Shelby and our puppy Ragù are incredibly lucky, and we as owners are so happy to have discovered them. Highly recommended for their outstanding professional service, and above all, for the genuine warmth and love they put into their work.
Emiliana is amazing! Highly recommend her practice if you have a pet!
Excellent set up and staff are very friendly and helpful too.

Genevieve and Emiliana are great vets! Always available to listen and help. I was there recently for one of my cats, they visited him thoroughly, listened to all my concerns and were able to help with a cure that worked. The clinic is also very clean, nice and welcoming. Great price for the service offered. Highly recommended!

Honestly the best Vets we have been to. The calming atmosphere, the genuine interest and love of animals is notable the second you walk in the door.  Lena is so amazing and Vets are so gentle and thorough.  Our lola is normally terrified but she really senses the calmness of the clinic. It's so affordable too. Absolute gem of a clinic.

Visited the clinic for some issues my cat Luna was having with his eye and all the staff and the vet Genevieve who cared for Luna showed so much compassion and love for my cat while he was in their care. We were taken care of from the moment we entered to when we left. Time was spent thoroughly examining Luna and giving him lots of cuddles and kisses to make him comfortable! Luna was given a toy as a treat at the end of his visit. Delighted to have found such a brilliant vet after years of difficulties with vets not showing a true love for animals and their care.

I cannot recommend My Pawsome Veterinary Clinic highly enough.

When our dog became critically ill, our own vet had no appointments available, so we contacted My Pawsome in desperation. Even though the clinic was incredibly busy, they found the time to fit him in as an emergency. From the moment we arrived, we were treated with such kindness, compassion and professionalism.

Within minutes, the team had carried out blood tests, and later that same day they diagnosed our dog with a very serious illness. Because of their quick action and expertise, we were able to get the vital medication he urgently needed. We truly believe their prompt care made an enormous difference.

Every member of staff was kind, caring, respectful and genuinely compassionate. They not only looked after our dog but also supported our whole family through a very frightening time. We never felt rushed, despite how busy they were, and they made us feel completely welcome and cared for.

The clinic itself is absolutely beautiful. It's so modern, bright and comfortable that I honestly thought I'd walked into a luxury beauty salon rather than a veterinary practice! It has such a calm and welcoming atmosphere, which helped put both us and our dog at ease.

Thank you to everyone at My Pawsome for your outstanding care, dedication and genuine compassion. We will never forget the difference you made for our beloved dog and our family. You are an exceptional team, and we are incredibly grateful.

Highly recommend this vet . I attended for a referral cardiac scan for my dog. The level of kindness and compassion from the wonderful vet and receptionist Lena were amazing. Thank you again for being so caring.

Emi has been my fur babies' vet for more than twenty years. There are no words that could adequately describe what a magnificent vet she truly is. She is compassionate, warm and welcoming. Her knowledge is exceptional and she will go the extra mile to help her little patients. Her new business is fabulous. It is a warm and welcoming environment (more like a spa) with warm, friendly and caring staff (Genevieve, Lena and Tanya). I have no hesitation in recommending this practice to anyone.
A fantastic Veterinary practice.  I cannot rate Emiliana and all the team highly enough.  They were so understanding of my worries regarding my dog, and they looked after her so well :)

As a Veterinary Nurse I can say that Emiliana and her team are absolutely and utterly fabulous, kind, caring, compassionate and knowledgeable.
Emiliana looked after my mams dog today performing a detailed ultrasound scan. And was all positive news ❤️
Lena who booked us in and met us when we arrived is worth her weight in gold. She is so welcoming and pleasant.
If your looking for a veterinary practice look no further.
Premium service and a true spa-like atmosphere

I honestly could not recommend this clinic more. I attended here last week with my beloved dog Cody. There was some concern regarding possible cardiology issues so it was a very anxious visit. However, from the moment we walked in, Emi, Tanya and Lenie/Leni (apologies if i misspelled your name) were so so kind and caring, and could not have done more for both Cody and I.

Cody was treated with so much kindness, compassion and reassurance. He was spoilt with treats, food, ice cream and a little bandana that Tanya so kindly picked out. Emi left no stone unturned when assessing him.

I cannot thank you enough for the kindness you showed and thank you so much for making a difficult day easier for us. I’ll never forget the care Cody received here❤️

1st visit too Pawsome today with Lola, lovely experience, very helpful and friendly staff. It is great to see another new business opening in the bayside area, wishing all at Pawsome every success in their new journey.
